title: Vice Atlas — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Tracker
note: Official trophy names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's published words, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (Nov 2026). Every guide below was written fresh in our own words for this entry from the cited published guides (PowerPyx's trophy guide, read in full 21 Nov 2026, plus DamnModz, GameSpot, The Games Wiki, GTABase, GTA Vibes and games.gg) and names its sources; a guide marked provisional says so because no published guide had pinned its method down by 21 Nov 2026. Seven guides were newly confirmed from launch-week play on 20–21 Nov 2026, each backed by two or more independent guides except Ten Pin, whose exact count is now agreed by PowerPyx and DamnModz. Hidden flags corrected in this rebuild to 28 hidden (games.gg, Insider Gaming and CryptoGames all list 28): Challenging Tank is hidden, while Hot Together and Retail Therapy are not.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks by itself — no separate task, no online play, no DLC. PowerPyx puts the whole platinum run at roughly 200 hours at difficulty 4/10, so follow the roadmap stages in order and this closes the set.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the first story mission in Chapter 1. It is the opening mission of the game, so this is the first trophy almost every player earns, and it unlocks automatically.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through every story mission of Chapter 1; the trophy pops when the chapter ends. While you are still in Chapter 1, do the first meditation at Jason's house — see Positive Mental Attitude — because that one does not come back.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission of Chapter 2. Chapter trophies unlock on their own at the chapter's end, so just keep playing the story.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission of Chapter 3. Automatic and unmissable — the chapter's closing mission is the trigger.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission of Chapter 4. Automatic and unmissable; by now the story is in its final stretch.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission in Chapter 5. The story runs five chapters and takes about 60 to 80 hours, per PowerPyx; after the credits the 100% checklist opens and the cleanup stages begin.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. Mission trophies unlock automatically when the mission ends — if a mission fails, retry from the checkpoint and finish it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. Automatic and unmissable; it pops when the mission's final objective is done.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. Automatic and unmissable — finish the mission and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners in Chapter 4. Automatic and unmissable; it pops at the mission's conclusion.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. Automatic and unmissable — complete the mission and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. Automatic and unmissable; it is one of the named story missions, so it pops as the story passes through it.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Open the 100% checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) once it appears after the story — progress made earlier still counts. PowerPyx calls this the hardest trophy, but the checklist is lenient: closer to 60% of true completion, most side quests not required, and collectibles only partly required — 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned and 100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars. Work the other trophies first; most of the checklist fills itself in along the way.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 base jumps, per PowerPyx. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 — under-the-bridge flights are the quickest to farm, and stunt jumps are the easiest bulk source. Track progress under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race or drone race, and performing a stunt. The tracker counts 9 types (Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities); a single try of each is enough, no win required. Most of them happen naturally while you work the other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 12 ranges, 42 gold medals in total, per PowerPyx. Work through each range's weapon drills one by one; gold needs speed and accuracy together, so learn a challenge's target order before going for time.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — 42 drone races in total, per PowerPyx. Each location is its own race, so a win anywhere counts once per spot; fly low through the gates rather than climbing, because the racing line matters more than top speed.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not count twice. There are 40 unique race locations, per PowerPyx, spanning street, off-road and water events; pick a series, learn its shortest route, and move on once you have the win.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, when you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing location west of Key Lento marked with a purple icon. Take the challenge there and out-fish him — use the best rod and bait you can buy and fish the marked spots.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one of the 4 arcade games — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1; the fourth is on arcade machines around the world. 'Complete' means finishing all of a game's levels at least once; you don't need to beat every challenge.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's strand — Lucia only. It opens in Chapter 3 when Andy calls and texts her home address in Belville. Five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass. All quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving strand. It opens in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams (Work for Kenton); he is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento and sends you to 7 shipwrecks — find the underwater treasures with the metal detector and bring them back. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2–3 (calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds it up). Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand. It opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes. All quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands that count — not every side quest counts (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie don't, per PowerPyx). Confirmed counting strands: Kirk's Skunk Ape hunts, Kyle's farm jobs, Yago's street races, and Pilot Pete's deliveries — that's already more than 8 quests across four givers, and more strangers are still being found. Track your count in the trophy list.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List strand. It opens in Chapter 3 after Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, when you steal the Zorrusso for Randy; he then wants 16 sports cars delivered. Track the list under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List, and scan cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is wanted — high-end sports cars turn up most often around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. Deliveries pay more when the car arrives in good condition.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand — Jason only. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers point to Synthetic Labs in Vice City, and you destroy them in Take Out Kitty Litter until Tyrone gives you the Spin On This job. All of it stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot: 18 spots across 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts double. THIS IS THE ONLY POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY — PowerPyx and GTABase both flag it. The first meditation is offered at Jason's house in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept — that spot is gone for good once Chapter 1 ends. Track progress under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. The final spot needs both characters together, which unlocks after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His strand opens after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when Jason gets a text from Bret Vogel marking Veteran Hunted in Lummox County (Lucia can't receive it). Bret gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle — retrieve it from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker — then hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed exactly which animal pops the trophy, so work through his requests in order.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — in shops, on the street and in hidden spots — and each set needs every card in it; PowerPyx's guide lists 18 card-set locations. Collect as you travel and use the in-game collection screen to see which cards each set is still missing.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It action at 100 different locations — scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures by holding Up then R1 near them (31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, per PowerPyx). There are more than 100 in total, so any 100 count; hit one whenever you pass it during other stages and the count climbs on its own.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges — the 100% checklist wants 70, so this pops on the way there. Challenges cover driving, shooting, flying and exploration; many complete themselves while you chase other trophies. Track them under Progress, then Challenges, and pick the easiest remaining ones last.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. It unlocks after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can call your partner (hold Right, then Triangle). The easiest escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter can't see you — and the trophy pops once you drive out of the red heat zone. It also comes automatically during the Chapter 4 bank-vault mission, which always triggers a 4-star response.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level — the stars must stay up from the first till to the third. It unlocks after Chapter 2's Coffee Break; hit 3 robbery targets (green icons) while being chased, keeping the flashing wanted level rather than the red heat level. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing items, and drive straight from one shop to the next.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — scanning one with the WAiNK app is enough, you don't need to drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan the traffic passing by (hold Up to open WAiNK, then R1 to scan). The 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 base models scanned, so this is a milestone on the way there; check what you've found under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus — press L3 + R3 while aiming to slow time and highlight weak spots. Buff your focus first with food, drinks or a wash, and use Adrenaline to stretch the effect; a full-auto rifle like the Duke 556 and body armor help. It doesn't work on soldiers, police or civilians, so line up 5 gang enemies and chain the kills before the effect ends. Focus has 4 levels and grows as you play shooting ranges, golf, pool and fishing.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA and take off with it — the easiest is the one at terminals E3/E4. Drive through a fence around the airfield, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge into the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, drive backward to the airstrip and take off; fly about 1 km away from the airport before the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the military base on the south-west island of Leonida (Mariana County). The tanks stand at the south end of the base — drive in through the main gate or take the stunt jump by the south-eastern entrance, climb into a Rhino and drive it out; if the trophy doesn't pop, fire the cannon at the soldiers chasing you. Entering the base draws a wanted level, so save first. You can do this from Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors, and marks jewelry stores with green icons. Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun (don't kick it — that triggers the alarm), find the safe code note in the backroom, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm, then leave. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. The Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… introduces vault robberies: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open and rob it with your partner (hold Right to hand off a bag). After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips — he marks the vans with a purple icon — and work through the 8 Large Bank Jobs (you need all 8 for 100%, so this pops on the way). Vaults pay up to $205,000 each and instantly trigger a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The same Chapter 4 mission that unlocks bank vaults counts as a truck robbery, so it pops there — or intercept a truck driving near a bank on your own: block its path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open (sticky bombs come from the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests). The trophy only pops once you escape the red heat radius.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every area of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the entire map is visible. The coast, the swamps and the small towns are the ones players miss.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang is enough for the trophy, though the 100% checklist wants all 39. Operations are marked by yellow icons when you go near them, and you can track each gang's count under Progress, then Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Hotel on Ocean Beach and take the elevator up to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar — past the pool to the rooftop access door. Buy an Apple Martini ($10) from the bartender and drink it while standing at the bar, looking out over the beach. The trophy pops as you drink.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: After you get the Key Cloner in Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, go to the Sunrise Autos showroom in southern Vice City (Southside, near Peacock Bay). Clone the key of the blue Bravado Banshee convertible on display — only that car counts — get in and drive straight through the showroom's glass window, then keep driving down the street; the trophy pops a moment after you leave. A nod to the classic showroom escape from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — a gang operation you first visit during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. The luxury watch is in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun sits on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway opens with code 0300 or a sticky bomb. The trophy pops after you escape the police; if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later, so it isn't missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Strength is raised by working out — buy a gym membership and train together: after Chapter 2's Coffee Break you can switch between the characters, so call your partner to the gym with you and work out side by side; while one trains, the other gains progress too. Check each character's Strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia. Once both are maxed, the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — the trophy list itself shows your count out of 500. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile) and a small icon appears whenever an action counts: stealthy robberies and clean escapes, incapacitating enemies, or violent acts all feed it. It fills up through normal play while you work the other trophies; if it is the last one left, running over civilians and police with a car farms it fast — though a violent profile makes cops shoot on sight more often.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: PROVISIONAL — the method is still unconfirmed as of 21 Nov 2026, the only trophy in this guide without a confirmed method. The best lead, from PowerPyx and DamnModz: it is believed to be tied to the Payday Loans store from Lucia's prologue — rob that store in Little Cuba again, as Lucia and alone, after you get the Dye Pack Jammer in Chapter 3 (the Credit Check mission unlocks Payday Loans robberies). Treat this as the lead to test, not a fact, and check the cited guides for a confirmation.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: After Chapter 1, go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County after 2 a.m. in-game time. Look for a parked car with flickering lights and an open trunk — if it is not there, drive away and come back. Follow the trail from the car into the woods toward the blue light; approach the UFO, offer to help the woman it drops, and walk her back to her car. The UFO returns and abducts you instead — and the trophy pops. The event is random, so it may take a few visits, and either Jason or Lucia can trigger it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock pedestrians over with a kick from a moving motorbike or bicycle — press Square to kick while riding. PowerPyx and DamnModz agree the trophy tracks 10 kicks within 60 seconds, so ride a busy stretch — Ocean Beach or a crowded Vice City street — and kick as you pass groups of pedestrians. If it does not pop at 10, keep kicking.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; hand them to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most) and the clean money counts toward the total, across all robberies — bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single job.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, vehicles, food, tattoos, anything that takes money. It is cumulative across the whole game, so normal spending counts; the fastest route is the expensive stuff — guns, car mods and tattoos. Check the stats screen for your lifetime spend.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garage properties (there are 4 more story garages, but they don't count). Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone — buy them through the app. They cost $160,000 in total; robberies in Chapters 3–4 are the quickest way to fund them. Garages also give you parking spots for the Scooter Bros registrations.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app lands on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). You need enough garages first — each garage adds parking spots — then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register (later, in Chapter 3, you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray). Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
